text:
Type: white shaggy curly throw
Use: warmth and texture on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, bohemian, contemporary
Materials: soft thick looped pile fabric, sheepskin-like texture
Colors: white, warm off-white
Shape: rectangular blanket covered in dense curly loops, plush and fluffy surface, soft bulky folds, cloud-like texture, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, soft, warm, inviting
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, light wood, knitted cushions, wool rugs; Scandinavian, bohemian or contemporary living rooms and bedrooms
